description: The publish view lists your submissions with their state: received, being checked, did not pass its checks, waiting for approval, publishing, published, withdrawn, replaced, stuck. Open a failed one to read the check results meant for the author: the kinds of warnings and bounded detail, never the model's full text or admin notes. Mail uses fixed wording and a link, never your submission text, at most five a day per recipient, and sends only where the catalog's community mail is switched on.
examples: A skill whose gate failed shows did not pass its checks with the failing gate named; fix and resubmit.
how_to: Open publish a skill and read the state beside each submission.
Open a row that did not pass to see its check results.
Look for the mail after a failed check or a publish.
name: Submission status and mail
summary: authors see where each submission stands in the app and get a short mail when a check fails or the item publishes.
where: The skills catalog, PUBLISH A SKILL, your submissions.
